key_concepts: Skeleton equations show reactants and products without balancing
Balanced chemical equations obey conservation of mass
Combination reactions form one product from two or more reactants
Decomposition reactions break compounds into simpler substances
Single replacement reactions use the activity series to predict displacement
Double replacement reactions exchange ions between compounds
Complete combustion of hydrocarbons yields carbon dioxide, water, and heat
Incomplete combustion yields carbon monoxide, water, and heat
Metal oxides with water form bases; nonmetal oxides with water form oxyacids
Heating carbonates or bicarbonates releases carbon dioxide
Magnesium ribbon burns in oxygen to form magnesium oxide
